findings.title: Expansion review repeats an eye-catch-only observation
findings.evidence: The review declares scope="this batch only" but observation starts アイキャッチは輪郭がやや細く柔らかく. Archived b/audit.json B-KANGAROO-01 explicitly scopes that observation to eyecatch tea_bow and jump_dance. The batch status acceptable_with_notes is not contradicted.
findings.recommendation: Keep the preserved historical audit unchanged; replace this management overlay observation with an expansion-specific statement supported by archived group/source-sheet evidence.

findings.title: Final path-closure evidence is not present in the portable latest-result record
findings.evidence: The string says final metadata path closure checked below, but the JSON ends at this field. Additional closure=true and final hashes are only in output/character-asset-management-v001/verification.json. A portable consumer following manifest.latest_result cannot inspect that claimed evidence from this record.
findings.recommendation: Preserve this historical result and add a new result with concrete current round-trip verification details and self-contained evidence references; point the management manifest at that new result.

findings.title: Eye-catch batch observation also includes an explicitly named expansion comparison
findings.evidence: scope="this batch only", yet the body-fill clause explicitly describes 拡充版の胴. This is not a false label because the other set is named, but the own-batch fill conclusion is omitted. Archived a/findings.json says eye-catch neutral torso close to canonical (117/57/35 versus120/57/33).
findings.recommendation: For clarity, use this batch's contour observation plus the supported eye-catch body-fill comparison. Leave the expansion observation attached to motions/v002.

limitations: No new visual style acceptance was inferred. This review verifies management records, documentary scope and preservation, not complete MP4 playback or a fresh 414-pose visual audit.

Generic-index unchanged history was asserted by the management record; this review independently recomputed the 1097-character-file preservation baseline, not a missing historical pre-management generic-index hash.
Parent manager is applying overlay corrections and will publish final verification separately; this report records the initial inspected state.
